subsystem.name: VehicleAIAndPit
subsystem.responsibility: Reconstructs the vehicle AI and pit subsystem: per-session AI performance timing and per-vehicle bias assignment over the active grid (AISessionTiming), tire-ground contact force (TireContactSolver), tire temperature thermal model (TireThermalState), tire-load factor recording, tire slip-curve / name resolution, tire-wear/grip property table maintenance, plus the helper objects sharing this packet's call graph (particle spawner, linked lists, pointer pair store, timer slot array, UI texture-coordinate group, network-socket manager, audio gain, bit array).

summary: DERIVED architecture proposal for wave_005_vehicle_ai_and_pit_02 covering 27 validated function IR entries. Core vehicle AI/pit responsibilities: AIBehaviorInitialization (0x004BF0A0) sets up per-session timing and assigns randomized per-vehicle speed/top-speed biases over the active grid, then re-sorts AI drivers; TireLoadFactorSetter, TireContactForceComputation, WheelTireForceUpdate and the tire-name/slip-curve lookups implement the per-wheel tire physics and configuration; TireWearPropertyStore maintains the 45-entry tire-wear/grip tables. Supporting helpers in the packet (particle spawner, linked lists, socket init, audio, bit array) are grouped conservatively; several scope-external functions and all read-only constant globals are left unresolved rather than forced into the design.

function_roles.role: AISessionTiming::initialize - per-session AI performance timing setup: stores session-time base and identifier, wires vehicle behavior parameters, sets animation state, assigns randomized per-vehicle speed/top-speed biases over the active grid and re-sorts AI drivers.
TrailParticleSpawner::spawnTrailParticle - allocates a circular-buffer particle slot and initializes it from collision data (position, velocity, noise-scaled magnitude, collision normal).
TireLoadFactorRecord::setLoadFactors - writes the four tire-load-factor doubles: average, half-difference, incoming load and its reciprocal; gated debug log on non-positive load.
TireSlipCurveTable::lookupByName - searches a 24-byte-stride tire slip-curve name table for a matching entry name; returns the entry address or 0.

TireContactSolver::computeContactForce - per-tire contact force computation: collision normal query, penetration depth, spring/damper normal force, slip velocity projection and saturation, writes tire force terms.
WheelTireForceUpdate - per-frame tire temperature thermal update: two temperature integrations blended to ambient, then four-corner normalization into [0,1] through the wheel-base pointer.
TireSlipCurveTable::resolveTireName - resolves a tire name string from a compound index pair via CompoundIndexLookup; falls back to the default path string on lookup failure.
AIReplayStatePredicate::isActive - boolean predicate: TRUE only when the per-vehicle AI/replay state pointer is non-null and its active flag equals 1.
TireWearPropertyStore::cleanupTable - teardown helper walking a fixed 45-entry, 20-byte-stride heap-pointer table, freeing each non-null entry; returns the last processed pointer.
TireWearPropertyStore::initGripDataArray - initializes a 45-entry array of 5-dword tire-grip records with sentinel values, calling StringCopyWithBufferRealloc per record.
TireWearPropertyStore::cleanupTableB - structural twin of 0x004F6B00: frees a second 45-entry, 20-byte-stride heap-pointer table; returns the last processed pointer.
TireWearPropertyStore::initSlot - initializes a tire-slot struct: seeds default path string, marks slot identifiers -1, clears active flag, returns -1.
PhysicsDefaultsInitializer::initDefaults - constructor/initializer: zeroes 43 dword fields, sets gravity (-9.81), unity scalar (1.0) and four -1 sentinels; returns this.
ObjectCleanupChain::cleanupThree - guarded three-object teardown: partially resets the first object via LargeStructPartialReset, delegates each non-null object and zeroes its slot.
SpriteFrameController::resetAndSelectFrame - resets the animation index dword to zero, then chains to the SpriteFrameSelector helper and returns its result.
WheelGeometryTableStore::initGeometryTables - allocates four 1024-dword lookup tables via vtable-slot-0 dispatch and fills them with four arithmetic progressions.
LinkedListTailInsert::insertTail - unlinks node a2 from its list and appends it at this list's tail, rebinding a2's owner to this.
PointerPairStore::storePair - trivial setter storing two pointer arguments at this+0x1A4 and this+0x1A8, returning the first.
DoublyLinkedListTailInsertion::insertTail - inserts node a2 at the tail of a doubly linked list rooted at this[62], promoting a2 to head on the empty-list path.
TimerSlotArray::boundsCheckAndReset - index bounds check against dword_8B8E48 + 32; in-range returns HighResolutionTimerReset on the 19-dword-stride slot array, otherwise the sentinel.
TextureCoordinatePropertyGroup::setAndUpdate - stores three texture-coordinate parameters, calls DirectXVertexBufferTextureCoordinateSetup, sets the dirty bit 0x800 on the shared state dword.
NetworkSocketManager::initialize - multi-stage network-socket initialisation chain with error propagation and a conditional polling loop.
AIChainCallWrapper::dispatch - fastcall wrapper: dispatches an indirect function pointer, discards its result, returns AlignedMemoryCopyFromStructBuffer(a1, a2, a3).
NetworkSocketManager::initSockAddrPair - initializes two AF_INET socket address structures (family 2, htons(0), htonl(0)) in network byte order.
LinkedListDestructorChain::destroy - destroys a linked list rooted at this+0x0: optional data-block callback under SEH, frees nodes/blocks, zeroes the four list dwords.
AudioGainControl::incrementGain - increments a single byte field by a signed char, then calls MutexWaitWith1msTimeoutRelease and returns its result.
BitArray::incrementCarryPropagate - increments a bit position in a 32-bit-word array with overflow carry propagation across preceding words.

classes.name: AISessionTiming
classes.responsibility: Per-session AI performance timing: holds the session-time base, caller-supplied session identifier, processed-count threshold and vehicle-behavior parameter pointer used when assigning randomized per-vehicle speed and top-speed biases over the active grid and re-sorting AI drivers.

classes.name: TrailParticleSpawner
classes.responsibility: Circular-buffer particle spawner: allocates a particle slot, seeds it from collision data (position, velocity, noise-scaled magnitude, collision normal) and sets texture-layer / array-element flags with bounds-checked array writes.

classes.name: TireLoadFactorRecord
classes.responsibility: Per-wheel tire-load factor record: four consecutive doubles written each frame - average of two load inputs, half-difference, the incoming load and its reciprocal.

classes.name: TireSlipCurveTable
classes.responsibility: Tire configuration name table: looks up a slip-curve name entry (24-byte stride) by name, and resolves a tire name from a compound index pair with a default-path fallback.

classes.name: TireContactSolver
classes.responsibility: Per-tire ground-contact force computation: queries the track-surface collision normal, computes penetration depth and spring/damper normal force, projects slip velocity onto the surface and lateral bases with a saturation guard, and writes the resulting force terms into the tire contact state.

classes.name: TireThermalState
classes.responsibility: Per-frame tire temperature model: two thermal integrations from absolute slip inputs and friction/convection coefficients blended toward an ambient reference, then four-corner temperature normalization into [0,1] stored through the wheel-base pointer.

classes.name: AIReplayStatePredicate
classes.responsibility: Boolean predicate over the per-vehicle AI/replay state object: returns TRUE only when the state pointer at this+0x3A9C is non-null and the dword at byte offset 300 of that object equals 1; gates overtaking logic.

classes.name: TireWearPropertyStore
classes.responsibility: Tire-wear / grip property tables: initializes the 45-entry 5-dword grip-data array and tire slot structs, and tears down the two 45-entry, 20-byte-stride heap-pointer tables.

classes.name: PhysicsDefaultsInitializer
classes.responsibility: Constructor/initializer of an AI/physics-side object: zeroes 43 dword fields, sets the gravity constant (-9.81), a unity scalar (1.0) and four -1 sentinels; returns this unchanged.

classes.name: ObjectCleanupChain
classes.responsibility: Guarded three-object teardown helper: reads up to three pointer slots, partially resets the first object via LargeStructPartialReset, then delegates each non-null object through GuardedDelegate and zeroes the corresponding slot.

classes.name: SpriteFrameController
classes.responsibility: Sprite/animation frame controller: resets the animation index field, then chains to the frame selector helper.

classes.name: WheelGeometryTableStore
classes.responsibility: Wheel data sub-struct initializer: allocates four 1024-dword lookup tables through vtable-slot-0 dispatch into the sub-struct at this+0x19C and fills them with arithmetic progressions.

classes.name: LinkedListTailInsert
classes.responsibility: Doubly-linked-list tail insertion helper: unlinks a node from its current list and appends it at this list's tail, updating the global list tail and rebinding the node's owner.

classes.name: PointerPairStore
classes.responsibility: Trivial setter used by AI/graphics dispatch callers to record a pair of pointer values on the receiver.

classes.name: DoublyLinkedListTailInsertion
classes.responsibility: Doubly-linked-list tail insertion: walks next pointers from this[172] to the tail and links the node in, promoting it to head when the list rooted at this[62] is empty.

classes.name: TimerSlotArray
classes.responsibility: Index bounds check for a fixed-size slot array: computes the upper sentinel from dword_8B8E48 and addresses a 19-dword-stride slot in dword_8B6C28, resetting its high-resolution timer when in range.

classes.name: TextureCoordinatePropertyGroup
classes.responsibility: UI/graphics property group: stores three texture-coordinate parameters, wires the DirectX vertex-buffer texture-coordinate setup, and sets the shared dirty flag bit.

classes.name: NetworkSocketManager
classes.responsibility: Network-socket manager: multi-stage initialisation chain with error propagation over the socket array, a UDP broadcast socket and a follow-up setup stage, plus the socket-address (sockaddr) initialization for two AF_INET endpoints.

classes.name: AIChainCallWrapper
classes.responsibility: Fastcall dispatch wrapper on the AI subsystem path: dispatches an indirect function pointer (result discarded) then returns the aligned memory-copy helper result.

classes.name: LinkedListDestructorChain
classes.responsibility: Linked-list destructor: walks the node chain, optionally processes each node's data block via an SEH-guarded callback loop, frees all blocks/nodes, zeroes the four list fields and returns 0.

classes.name: AudioGainControl
classes.responsibility: Audio gain/volume accumulator: increments a single byte field by a signed char and follows with a mutex wait-with-timeout. Volume reading is inferred from the legacy ABI label only.

classes.name: BitArray
classes.responsibility: Big bit-array word update: adds a single-bit mask into the addressed 32-bit word and propagates the carry across preceding words while the overflow-checked addition reports overflow.

interfaces.name: TireNameResolution
interfaces.purpose: Resolve a tire/slip-curve name string from a config table (24-byte-stride name entries) or from a compound index pair, with a default-path fallback.

interfaces.name: TireWearTableMaintenance
interfaces.purpose: Initialize and tear down the 45-entry tire-wear/grip property tables anchored at globals; both teardown twins free non-null entries at a 20-byte stride.

compatibility_contracts.name: TireLoadFactorRecordLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: The per-wheel tire-load record is four consecutive doubles at receiver offsets 0x0 (load average), 0x8 (half-difference), 0x10 (load value) and 0x18 (reciprocal); TireLoadFactorSetter writes all four per frame from TireCompoundPerWheelPhysicsApplication.

compatibility_contracts.name: TireSlipCurveTableLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: The slip-curve name table exposes entry count at +0x8 and the entry array at +0xC with a 24-byte stride; each entry name lives at the entry base, a null name falls back to byte_5EA438, and a match is detected by sub_588410 returning 0.

compatibility_contracts.name: AISessionTimingOffsets
compatibility_contracts.description: The AI session-timing object stores the session-time base at +0x354, caller-supplied session identifier at +0x358, processed-count threshold at +0x35C and vehicle-behavior parameter pointer at +0x360; per-vehicle speed-bias base sits at +0x34C. AIBehaviorInitialization is the session entry point called from AIOvertake.

compatibility_contracts.name: TireTemperatureNormalizationRange
compatibility_contracts.description: Each frame the four corner temperatures are normalized into [0,1] (linear map clamped at both ends) and stored through the wheel-base pointer at +0x8CC; consumers of those normalized per-corner values must expect the same range.

compatibility_contracts.name: TireWearTableTeardownContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Both teardown twins (0x004F6B00 and 0x004F6B90) walk a 45-entry, 20-byte-stride heap-pointer table, free each non-null entry through FreeWrapper_7bcf and return the last processed pointer; a replacement must preserve the table anchors (byte_8AFC74 / unk_8AF8EC) and stride.
